paragraphs: Minyomi son of Rav Naḥumi, in Rava and Rav Yosef's time, HaMekabbel 109b; see there. R. Ashi said: R. Minyomi bar Naḥumi said. He stood before Amemar, Ketubbot 69a, 81b. See his entry: Amemar lived long after Rava. How could Minyomi, who stood before Amemar, live in Rav Yosef and Rava's time?
